output.reasoning: This posting fails on both role type and level. Role type: the 'Applied AI Architect, Public Sector (Federal Civilian)' is a pre-sales, customer-facing technical advisory role. The work is partnering with account executives, serving as a technical advisor to government agencies, delivering technical content to executives, navigating buying cycles, and traveling frequently to customer sites. It is not hands-on engineering that builds, trains, and deploys ML/NLP systems, which is what Ananya's target roles (Machine Learning Engineer, AI Engineer, Applied NLP Engineer, ML Engineer, Research Engineer) call for. Her experience as an ML Engineer Co-op (RAG prototype, fine-tuning a transformer classifier, MLflow tracking) fits builder roles, not sales engineering. Level: the posting explicitly requires '5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager.' That exceeds the 3+ year exclusion threshold. Ananya is a new grad finishing her MS at Boston University in 2026-12 with only an 8-month co-op. It also requires prior experience working with US federal agencies, which she lacks. Skills: the required section names fewer than 2 specific technologies (only Python), so the skills test is skipped. Location (San Francisco, CA / New York City, NY, hybrid) is US-based and acceptable given her willingness to relocate. Sponsorship is offered ('We do sponsor visas!'), which fits her sponsorship need. Even so, the role-type and level failures make this NOT_RELEVANT.
